biggest_catch: On-the-spot cash is real, but it is a reseller's offer: expect well under private-sale value, and the store only buys what it wants to stock.
catches: Offers depend on condition, brand, and demand; the store can decline items.
On-the-spot offers are below private-sale prices.
You must visit a physical store location.
Trading toward store product (instead of cash) may yield a higher number, but it is store credit.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

c1.evidence: Official musicgoround.com sell page documents the in-store buying program.

c2.evidence: Official page: paid on the spot or traded for store product.

c3.evidence: Official page: on-the-spot payment after evaluation.

c4.evidence: No fee to get an offer.

eligibility: Must own the gear; store locations only.
maximize: Take trade credit over cash if you'd buy strings, sticks, or gear there - the trade number is usually higher. Clean the instrument first; presentation matters at the counter.
notes: Observed 2026-09-23 on musicgoround.com official sell page. Numeric keys are example-based estimates for a typical single item, labeled per lane rules; official terms give no payout floor and state value varies by condition and demand - actual offers are per-item and can be $0 if the item is not accepted.
payout_quote: Bring us your instruments and gear - we evaluate them in store and pay you on the spot, or you can trade toward store product.

repeatable.cadence: You can do this once per instrument you own - it is bounded by the gear you already have, not a daily income stream.

s4.note: Evaluation is free with no obligation.

s5.note: Offer shown before you hand over the gear.

steps: Bring your instrument or related gear to a Music Go Round store
Accept the cash offer or trade toward store product
timing: Paid on the spot after in-store evaluation (cash or trade toward store product).
who_pays: Music Go Round - the store pays you directly on the spot, in cash or as trade toward store product.
who_qualifies: You must own the gear and be able to visit a Music Go Round store in person.
work_available: Yes - stores were buying on the spot as of 2026-09-23. But the store only buys what it wants to stock, so acceptance is never guaranteed.
what_gets_accepted: Staff evaluate condition, brand, and demand in store. Clean the instrument first - presentation matters at the counter. The trade number is usually higher than cash, but it is store credit.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; no shipping since you bring gear in. Your unpaid time is the trip to the store.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash on the spot after in-store evaluation - or a higher number as trade credit toward store product if you would buy strings, sticks, or gear there anyway.
